verdict.rationale: Tavily is fundamentally an API product. It publishes per-endpoint reference docs for Search, Extract, Crawl, Map and Research (including async status retrieval and streaming), plus Usage and Logs endpoints, documented rate limits with 429/retry-after semantics, and official Python and JS SDKs. A community user confirms having agents call the Tavily API. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found 404 at all candidate paths), deeper independent hands-on corroboration.
